title: Fact-checking agent with Google ADK
description: Send a claim to a Google ADK agent that verifies it with Google Search on Gemini and returns a verdict and its sources through Neon AI Gateway.

environment.name: FACT_CHECK_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: A random token of at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32, that callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Neon Function URLs are public, so the function requires it.
